description: Stage one file on this server: returns a url and an upload_id. A staged file is inert until imported. The url works for 7 days and takes the file from whoever holds it, with no other credentials; opened in a browser, it is a page to pick the file and send it, so it reaches files on the user's phone or computer, including one attached in a chat that isn't handed to you. Files the user drops on their upload page, https://cuttingfloor.ai/account#files, are staged too.

bytes.description: The file size, to be refused now rather than part way if it is too big

name.description: The file's name, if known. A label only: the file the user picks on the page brings its own name, and import reads the content, not the extension

name: media.upload

expiry.description: expires_at in words: the link and a file sent through it go then unless imported

url.description: The staging url; no other credentials needed

title: Upload media
